items.label: USAO-MA civil: Merck Sharp & Dohme
items.detail: Civil False Claims Act settlement over Vioxx cardiovascular safety statements and off-label rheumatoid arthritis promotion; date is the announcement date. Release states $628,364,000 total civil: $426,389,000 recovered by the United States and $201,975,000 to participating Medicaid states. The separate $321,636,000 criminal fine from the guilty plea is not counted. Release is silent on admission in the civil settlement.

items.label: MA-AG civil: Merck & Co., Inc.
items.detail: Settlement of AG False Claims Act Medicaid lawsuit over inflated albuterol prices reported by Merck and its subsidiary Warrick, ending appeals after an $18 million judgment; date is the announcement date. Merck pays $24 million.
